description: Combine Brotli insert-length and copy-length codes into a command prefix code, with a packed constant table for the cell offset (CombineLengthCodes)
notes: Brotli 1.1.0, CombineLengthCodes (c/enc/command.h), with BROTLI_BOOL as int. Written by us from the function. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: a branch on the short-code case, a variable shift of the 0x520D40 constant, masks, adds and ors: 29 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
